% !TeX program = pdflatex
%
% CV LAYOUT SOURCE OF TRUTH
% -----------------------------------------------------------------
% This file contains presentation/layout only.
% Python MUST NOT rewrite this file for each application.
%
% Python generates:
%   ../../generated/generated_cv_content.tex
%
% That generated file contains final literal document content and calls
% the presentation macros defined here.
% -----------------------------------------------------------------

% ============================================================
% ATS / TAGGED-PDF INITIALIZATION
% ============================================================

\IfFormatAtLeastTF{2025-11-01}{%
  \DocumentMetadata{
    pdfversion = 2.0,
    tagging    = on
  }%
}{%
  \DocumentMetadata{
    pdfversion = 2.0,
    testphase  = {phase-III,table}
  }%
}

\documentclass[11pt,a4paper]{article}

% ============================================================
% PACKAGES AND PAGE SETUP
% ============================================================

\usepackage[
  a4paper,
  left=2.50296cm,
  right=2.49943cm,
  top=2.77989cm,
  bottom=2.29306cm
]{geometry}

\usepackage{fix-cm}
\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}
\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}
\usepackage[sfdefault]{noto}

\input{glyphtounicode}
\pdfgentounicode=1

% Both supported languages are loaded.
% Python emits the final literal \selectlanguage{english} or
% \selectlanguage{ngerman} command into generated_cv_content.tex.
\usepackage[english,ngerman]{babel}

\usepackage{xcolor}
\usepackage{graphicx}
\usepackage{array}
\usepackage{tabularx}
\usepackage{etoolbox}
\usepackage{needspace}
\usepackage[nopatch=footnote]{microtype}
\usepackage[hidelinks,unicode]{hyperref}

\definecolor{CVBlue}{HTML}{4F81BD}

\pagestyle{empty}
\setlength{\parindent}{0pt}
\setlength{\parskip}{0pt}
\setlength{\fboxsep}{0pt}
\emergencystretch=1em

% ============================================================
% LAYOUT CONSTANTS
% ============================================================

\newlength{\CVDateColumnWidth}
\setlength{\CVDateColumnWidth}{5.00075cm}

\newlength{\CVPhotoWidth}
% \setlength{\CVPhotoWidth}{3.33022cm}
\setlength{\CVPhotoWidth}{4cm}

\newlength{\CVPhotoHeight}
% \setlength{\CVPhotoHeight}{4.99004cm}
\setlength{\CVPhotoHeight}{4cm}

\newlength{\CVPersonalTextWidth}
\setlength{\CVPersonalTextWidth}{15.99761cm}

\newlength{\CVPersonalDataTextWidth}
\setlength{\CVPersonalDataTextWidth}{11.92389cm}

% ============================================================
% GENERAL PRESENTATION
% ============================================================

\newcommand{\CVBodyFont}{\fontsize{11bp}{0.60854cm}\selectfont}
\newcommand{\CVTitleFont}{\fontsize{14bp}{0.59972cm}\selectfont}

% Decorative PDF content must not appear as meaningful ATS text.
\ExplSyntaxOn
\NewDocumentCommand{\CVArtifact}{m}{%
  \tag_mc_end_push:
  \tag_mc_begin:n { artifact }
  #1
  \tag_mc_end:
  \tag_mc_begin_pop:n { }
}
\ExplSyntaxOff

% The tabularx blocks are layout grids, not semantic data tables.
\ExplSyntaxOn
\keys_if_exist:nnT { __tag / setup } { table/tagging }
  {
    \BeforeBeginEnvironment{tabularx}{%
      \tagpdfsetup{table/tagging=presentation}%
    }
    \AfterEndEnvironment{tabularx}{%
      \tagpdfsetup{table/tagging=true}%
    }
  }
\ExplSyntaxOff

% Literal document title supplied by Python.
\newcommand{\CVDocumentTitle}[1]{%
  \noindent
  {\CVTitleFont\bfseries\color{CVBlue}#1\par}%
  \vspace{0.84667cm}%
}

% Standard section command with the reference visual appearance.
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\section{%
  \@startsection{section}{1}{\z@}%
    {0.67028cm}%
    {0.02cm}%
    {\CVBodyFont\bfseries}%
}
\makeatother

\newcommand{\CVSection}[1]{%
  \Needspace{4\baselineskip}%
  \section*{#1}%
  \vspace{-0.26458cm}%
  \noindent
  \CVArtifact{{\color{CVBlue}\rule{\CVPersonalTextWidth}{0.03528cm}}}\par
  \vspace{0.56444cm}%
}

% ============================================================
% PERSONAL DATA PRESENTATION
% ============================================================
%
% Python generates the rows in exact JSON insertion order.
% No field names are predefined here.
%
% Use exactly one:
%
%   \CVPersonalDataNoPhoto{<section heading>}{<rows>}
%
% or:
%
%   \CVPersonalDataWithPhoto{<section heading>}{<photo path>}{<rows>}
%
% Each row:
%
%   \CVPersonalDataRow{<literal field name>}{<literal field value>}
% ============================================================

\newcommand{\CVPersonalDataRow}[2]{%
  #1 & #2\\%
}

\newcommand{\CVPersonalDataTable}[1]{%
  {\CVBodyFont
    \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.18}%
    \begin{tabularx}{\CVPersonalDataTextWidth}{%
      @{}p{\CVDateColumnWidth}@{}>{\raggedright\arraybackslash}X@{}%
    }
      #1%
    \end{tabularx}%
  }%
}

\newcommand{\CVPersonalDataNoPhoto}[2]{%
  \CVSection{#1}%
  \noindent
  \begin{minipage}[t]{\CVPersonalTextWidth}
    \vspace{0pt}%
    \begin{minipage}[t]{\CVPersonalDataTextWidth}
      \vspace{0pt}%
      \CVPersonalDataTable{#2}%
    \end{minipage}%
  \end{minipage}%
  \par
}

\newcommand{\CVPersonalDataWithPhoto}[3]{%
  \CVSection{#1}%
  \noindent
  \begin{minipage}[t]{\CVPersonalTextWidth}
    \begin{minipage}[t]{\CVPersonalDataTextWidth}
      \vspace{0pt}%
      \CVPersonalDataTable{#3}%
    \end{minipage}%
    \hfill
    \begin{minipage}[t]{\CVPhotoWidth}
      \vspace{0pt}%
      \includegraphics[
        artifact,
        width=\CVPhotoWidth,
        % height=\CVPhotoHeight
      ]{#2}%
    \end{minipage}%
  \end{minipage}%
  \par
}

% ============================================================
% PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE PRESENTATION
% ============================================================
%
% Python supplies:
%   1 = already formatted literal date/range text
%   2 = complete literal right-column content
%
% No field-presence decisions occur here.
% ============================================================

\newcommand{\CVJobEntry}[2]{%
  \Needspace{7\baselineskip}%
  \noindent
  \begin{minipage}[t]{\CVDateColumnWidth}
    \vspace{0pt}%
    {\CVBodyFont #1}%
  \end{minipage}%
  \begin{minipage}[t]{\dimexpr\CVPersonalTextWidth-\CVDateColumnWidth\relax}
    \vspace{0pt}%
    {\CVBodyFont #2}%
  \end{minipage}%
  \par\vspace{0.35278cm}%
}

% ATS-friendly responsibility/task paragraph.
% Python emits this macro only for an actual task.
\newcommand{\CVTask}[1]{%
  \par\noindent
  \hangindent=0.75142cm
  \hangafter=1
  \makebox[0.75142cm][l]{%
    \hspace{0.14111cm}%
    \CVArtifact{\textcolor{CVBlue}{\rule{0.11994cm}{0.11994cm}}}%
  }#1\par
}

% ============================================================
% EDUCATION / ADDITIONAL ACTIVITY PRESENTATION
% ============================================================
%
% Python supplies:
%   1 = already formatted literal date/range text
%   2 = complete literal right-column content
%
% Python decides whether the entry/section exists.
% ============================================================

\newcommand{\CVActivityEntry}[2]{%
  \Needspace{3\baselineskip}%
  \noindent
  \begin{minipage}[t]{\CVDateColumnWidth}
    \vspace{0pt}%
    {\CVBodyFont #1}%
  \end{minipage}%
  \begin{minipage}[t]{\dimexpr\CVPersonalTextWidth-\CVDateColumnWidth\relax}
    \vspace{0pt}%
    {\CVBodyFont #2}%
  \end{minipage}%
  \par\vspace{0.35278cm}%
}

% ============================================================
% SKILLS PRESENTATION
% ============================================================
%
% Python resolves:
% - subsection/category labels
% - skill names
% - final localized level text
%
% Python emits rows directly.
%
% Row syntax:
%   \CVSkillRow{<category or empty>}{<skill>}{<final level text>}
% ============================================================

\newcommand{\CVSkillRow}[3]{%
  #1 & #2 & #3\\%
}

\newcommand{\CVSkillsTable}[1]{%
  \noindent
  {\CVBodyFont
    \renewcommand{\arraystretch}{1.18}%
    \begin{tabularx}{\CVPersonalTextWidth}{%
      @{}p{\CVDateColumnWidth}@{}p{5.00062cm}@{}X@{}%
    }
      #1%
    \end{tabularx}%
  }%
}

% Optional explicit vertical gap between skill subsections.
\newcommand{\CVSkillSubsectionGap}{\\[-0.32632cm]}

% ============================================================
% CLOSING / SIGNATURE PRESENTATION
% ============================================================
%
% Python emits \CVClosingLine with literal place/date.
% Python emits \CVSignatureImage only when a usable signature exists.
% ============================================================

\newcommand{\CVClosingLine}[2]{%
  \par\addvspace{1.05833cm}%
  {\CVBodyFont #1, #2\par}%
}

\newcommand{\CVSignatureImage}[1]{%
  \vspace{0.14111cm}%
  \includegraphics[
    artifact,
    width=4.36915cm,
    height=1.56633cm
  ]{#1}%
  \par
}

% DOCUMENT
% ============================================================

\begin{document}

% Python overwrites this file for every deterministic build.
\input{../../generated/generated_cv_content.tex}

\end{document}
